high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from a user named Massimo (@Rainmaker1973) on the platform X (formerly Twitter). The tweet reads: "This cloud rolled in like an actual tsunami over Portugal. It's actually called a roll cloud." The tweet includes a photograph that captures a dramatic scene at a beach. The sky is filled with a large, dark, rolling cloud that resembles a wave, creating a striking visual effect. The cloud appears to be moving rapidly towards the shore, giving the impression of a tsunami. The ocean is choppy, with waves crashing onto the sandy beach. Several people are visible
